title: incident-bot: enrich on-call diagnostics with SLO + telemetry context
author: Aisha Patel
description: Context: on-call diagnostics currently surface runbook links and raw error samples but lack SLO and telemetry context that would help triage and routing. Motivation: attach SLO metadata and recent telemetry snapshots to diagnostics payloads so on-call can make faster decisions and automated runbook suggestions can score relevance more accurately. What I changed: (1) added a ContextEnricher component that merges SLO metadata (service, objective, window, current burn rate) and a compact telemetry snapshot (top traces, recent error ratios, p95 latency) into on-call diagnostics; (2) extended the incident-bot diagnostics payload schema with optional fields under "slo_context" and "telemetry_snapshot" and kept backward compatibility behind a feature flag; (3) added a lightweight client in slo-toolkit to fetch SLO metadata and metrics with circuit-breaker + caching; (4) added runbook scoring tweaks to prefer runbooks tied to degraded SLOs; (5) updated UI helpers to display the new context compactly; (6) included integration tests and new unit tests; (7) documented the feature and rollout steps in docs/runbooks.md. Backwards compatibility: enrichment is behind feature flag "oncall.enrich_slo_telemetry" and falls back to the existing payload when the client fails or times out. Tests: unit tests for enricher, mocks for slo-toolkit client, integration test simulating an SLO breach and validating runbook ranking. Rollout plan: enable in staging -> monitor diagnostic payload size and latency -> enable in canary (5%) -> full rollout; metrics: diagnostics.payload_size, diagnostics.enricher_latency, diagnostics.slo_fetch_errors. Checklist: [x] design doc linked (ENG-4287) [x] unit tests [x] integration tests [x] docs updated [x] feature flagged [x] monitored in metrics. Notes: kept payload additions compact (string fields + small arrays) to avoid increasing token costs for downstream consumers that forward diagnostics into eval pipelines.

review_comments: Diego Morales (2025-11-15): This looks solid overall. Two asks: 1) Can we bound the size of telemetry_snapshot to avoid large payloads when traces are verbose? 2) Add a quick fallback path when slo-toolkit is rate limited so diagnostics degrade gracefully. Please add tests for both.

Aisha Patel (2025-11-15): Reply: added size cap (max 3 traces, each compacted to key fields) and circuit-breaker with cached last-known SLO. Added tests in context_enricher_test.go and an integration scenario that simulates rate limiting.
Priya Singh (2025-11-17): Minor nit: prefer context keys 'slo' and 'telemetry' vs 'slo_context' to match existing UI helpers; also update typing in TypeScript helper. Otherwise approve after rebase.
Aisha Patel (2025-11-17): Reply: renamed keys to 'slo' and 'telemetry', updated ui_helpers.ts typings and tests. Rebased onto main.
Liam O'Connor (2025-11-19): Verified integration test in staging. Observed ~12ms median added latency and payload size +1.2KB. Metrics look acceptable. Approving for merge.
release_notes: Incident-bot diagnostics can now include optional SLO metadata and a compact telemetry snapshot to improve on-call triage and automated runbook ranking.
Feature gated by oncall.enrich_slo_telemetry (disabled by default).
Observability: added diagnostics.payload_size and diagnostics.enricher_latency metrics to monitor impact.
No breaking changes: payload fields are optional and will be omitted when the feature is disabled or enrichment fails.
